newsitem.title: USA: Sears plans to open 30 stores in NYC - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears plans to open 30 stores in NYC - paper.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck & Co, which has said it plans to open 131 new full-line stores by 2000, will announce Friday a plan to open 30 new stores in New York City during that time, the Daily News reported today.

The paper added that a large department store will be opened in Manhattan, where a flagship store is tentatively planned for the New York Coliseum in midtown, if the state agrees. Another site will be chosen in Manhattan if Albany rejects the plan.
And in Brooklyn, a 288,000 square-foot store is expected to be opened in November, the News said.
When all of the new stores are opened, they are expected to create 1,500 jobs for the city, according to the paper.
